title: Both Branches Add a File
objective: Merge two branches that independently created notes.txt, preserving the note from each branch.
description: Both branches add a file at the same path. Git cannot choose which newly created version to keep. Resolve the add/add conflict by combining the two notes, then commit the merge.

lesson.principle: An add/add conflict means both branches created a file at the same path. Git cannot decide which content to keep.
lesson.question: What should the final notes.txt contain in this exercise?
options: Both the main and feature notes
lesson.explanation: Both notes are intentional. Combine them in one file, remove the conflict markers, and finish the merge.
pitfalls: Keeping only one side of the new file.
Forgetting git add notes.txt before git commit.

hints: Run git merge feature/notes and inspect git status. The file is marked as added by both branches.
Open notes.txt. Keep both the main note and the feature note, removing the conflict markers.
Run git add notes.txt, git commit, and git-conflict-lab check.
